modules.title: Welcome, scope and participation
modules.purpose: Establish adult eligibility, usable channel and willingness to proceed; explain AI support and limits.
modules.transition_condition: Person chooses to proceed with an accessible channel, or scope/access/participation needs are recorded.
modules.example_wording: I’m an AI assessment assistant. I can help organize what you tell me for professional review. You can skip questions, pause or stop. Would you like to begin?

modules.title: Person's story and initial orientation
modules.purpose: Start openly; retain volunteered symptoms, initial time course, functional impact and separate care priorities.
modules.transition_condition: Enough of the main concern is understood to choose a focused target; no fixed number of opening questions.
modules.example_wording: What has been troubling you, and what would you like help with?

modules.title: Early direct safety enquiry
modules.purpose: Ask directly about suicide-related concerns; clarify passive death wishes, suicidal thoughts and self-harm separately when relevant. Any concern may interrupt every module.
modules.transition_condition: Current review needs and unresolved safety information are recorded; concern routes to the reviewed setting-specific safety pathway, not routine completion.
modules.example_wording: Have you recently had thoughts of ending your life?

modules.title: Recent symptoms, timing and functioning
modules.purpose: Assess mood, interest/pleasure and the remaining relevant depressive symptom domains, with distress/function and baseline change. Preserve recent and longer periods separately.
modules.transition_condition: Core domains have meaningful coverage or explicit gaps; use local follow-up rules instead of exhaustive questioning about one symptom.
modules.example_wording: How has your mood been over the past two weeks?

modules.title: Important alternative explanations
modules.purpose: Review activation history, physical/neurological conditions, medicines/supplements and substance exposure; expand relevant findings using the existing focused packages.
modules.transition_condition: Relevant alternative evidence or unresolved work-up is recorded before a depressive-disorder formulation; missing data never rule an alternative out.
modules.example_wording: Have there been distinct periods when your energy or activity was very different from usual?

modules.title: Longitudinal course and previous care
modules.purpose: Clarify first onset, previous periods, recovery intervals, long-standing symptoms, past diagnoses/treatment and response, and relevant family history.
modules.transition_condition: A provisional timeline distinguishes current episode, longstanding background and previous episodes, with uncertainties retained.
modules.example_wording: Before this recent period, were there other times when you felt similarly?

modules.title: Applicable pattern and feature branches
modules.purpose: Use the branch index for menstrual timing, perinatal context, seasons, symptom features and unresolved/residual presentations. Verify each feature's applicability in its own package.
modules.transition_condition: Applicable branches are explored, deferred for longitudinal records, or retained for professional review; no requirement to ask every branch of every person.
modules.example_wording: Do these changes follow any recurring pattern over time?

modules.title: Broader context, coexisting concerns and care priorities
modules.purpose: Clarify relevant anxiety/trauma/loss, relationships, supports, stressors, sleep/cognitive concerns and care priorities. Avoid unnecessary trauma detail; distinguish clinical evidence from care context.
modules.transition_condition: Relevant context and coexisting pathways are recorded with priorities, barriers and remaining questions; topic refusal is respected.
modules.example_wording: What has changed in your day-to-day life since this began?

modules.title: Optional standardized measurement checkpoint
modules.purpose: Offer a separately specified appropriate measure if useful and acceptable. PHQ-2 is not required before PHQ-9, and neither is an all-type diagnostic gate.
modules.transition_condition: Tool result or reason not administered is recorded. Approved protocol/language, source answers, timeframe, missing-item policy and valid scoring are needed before use.
modules.example_wording: Would you be comfortable completing a brief questionnaire to help us record a baseline?

modules.title: Summary, correction and professional-review handoff
modules.purpose: Summarize supported findings, conflicts, periods, unresolved questions and review needs. Invite correction; organize candidate explanations without confirming diagnoses.
modules.transition_condition: Useful handoff is prepared, or assessment pauses with gaps. Professional approval is never inferred from silence or unavailable review.
modules.example_wording: Have I understood your experience correctly, or is there something you would change or add?

branch_index.purpose: Episode-level assessment; not every depressive episode establishes MDD.

branch_index.trigger: Longstanding low mood, incomplete recovery or unclear long-term baseline
branch_index.purpose: Differentiate persistent background and superimposed episodes using the adult course contract.

branch_index.trigger: Relevant menstrual/ovarian context established with consent; cyclicity may need clarification
branch_index.purpose: Distinguish a possible cycle-linked disorder from premenstrual worsening; prospective records may require later contacts.

branch_index.trigger: Potential medication/substance temporal relationship or uncertain relevant exposure
branch_index.purpose: Document exposure, withdrawal/change and timeline; temporal coincidence does not establish cause.

branch_index.trigger: Possible relevant physical/neurological illness or unexplained clinical presentation
branch_index.purpose: Document evidence and clinical work-up needed; no causal assignment from a chat or illness name.

branch_index.trigger: Significant depressive presentation does not clearly fit after relevant review, or important information remains unavailable
branch_index.purpose: Professional classification review; incompleteness is not automatically unspecified depressive disorder. No automated four-day rule.

branch_index.trigger: Applicable clues, consented life-stage context or an important feature still unclear
branch_index.purpose: Review perinatal/seasonal context and applicable anxious, mixed, melancholic, atypical, psychotic or catatonic features; do not attach every feature to every category.

branch_index.trigger: Brief core review or relevant evidence/uncertainty
branch_index.purpose: Focused bipolar, anxiety, trauma, adjustment, grief, psychosis, delirium, cognitive, sleep, medical and exposure pathways; not full diagnosis of every alternative.

selection_policy.followup_condition: Missing detail is applicable to this concept, not already answered for the same period, and useful for review or next selection.
selection_policy.burden_rule: Do not require every optional attribute or finish all details of one concept before reviewing other important domains; no fixed question count or clinical numeric priority score is established.
selection_policy.off_topic_rule: Extract relevant new information first; acknowledge it and update priority. Offer a gentle return only if the earlier target remains useful and the person wants to continue.
selection_policy.refusal_rule: Distinguish decline, unclear answer, not answered and not applicable; never coerce or mark a refused target absent.

project_coverage_states.supported: Relevant source-linked information is available for this particular target and period; not proof a diagnosis is established.
project_coverage_states.needs_clarification: Some information exists but its meaning, period or detail is unclear.
project_coverage_states.not_asked: No targeted enquiry yet; absence in the transcript is not symptom absence.
project_coverage_states.declined: Person chose not to discuss this target.
project_coverage_states.deferred: Target remains open for a later point/contact or professional work-up.
project_coverage_states.not_applicable: Documented applicability reason; not inferred from age, name or appearance.

unresolved_before_execution: clinical review of route and branch applicability
